title: On My Way to School
text: Hi! My name is Leo. Every morning, I go to school by bus. On the way, I see many cars and a big truck. Sometimes I see the subway go under the street. One day, an ambulance and a fire truck passed by very fast. After school, my father picks me up on his motorcycle. I like to see all the different vehicles!
